First Round: 1.3-1.4
Second Round: 1.10-1.11
Third Round:1.17-1.18
Fourth Round: 1.24 -1.25
Who can Join This Round(1.3 - 1.4) : Nov Below A Tier hosts
Event run time: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM AEDT
💃 Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room as a host at least 20 mins within the hour, and you can do all event formats you like!
